entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single inventory upgrade material icon for a classic fantasy MMORPG, displayed at only 36x36 pixels. Primary request: a compact beveled forged metal ingot made of deep emerald green RuneSteel, two simple luminous green rune grooves; dark green metal with crisp emerald specular edges. Three-quarter isometric view, centered complete object, simple bold silhouette, thick readable edges, hand-painted polished game inventory art. Fill approximately 82% of a square canvas; small consistent padding on every side. Transparent background with real alpha. A single ingot only. No text, letters, caption, border, tile frame, pedestal, ground plane, drop shadow, surrounding sparks, loose gems or extra objects. Strong readable volume and color separation even when downscaled to 36 pixels. This is one of a coherent family of metallic ingot icons.
